mentions.name: Kiln
mentions.description: Kiln is a simplified agent task orchestrator that uses the user's local Claude Code installation as the agent and GitHub as its interface. Users move cards across kanban columns (Backlog -> Research -> Plan -> Implement), and Kiln runs Claude locally, opens pull requests, and keeps everything tracked in GitHub. Open source under the MIT License.
